findings.title: integrate.test.ts flakes in the parallel integration tier (hook timeout at 20 s)
findings.repro: Run `bun run test:integration` three times in a row on the maintainer's Mac. Run 3 failed: (fail) integrate (W2, K6) > clean: rebase + fast-forward story branch checked out in a worktree [20081.93ms] — a beforeEach/afterEach hook timed out. 1 of 3 runs.
findings.detail: The same file timed out under parallel load during planning (D7, then at bun's 5 s). It still hits the 20 s limit in a hook under 12x parallel. Evidence: B20.md, B5-int-run3.log.

findings.title: AGENTS.md names contract.test.ts at its old path
findings.repro: AGENTS.md:24 says contract.test.ts is in packages/adapters/test/contract/; `test -e packages/adapters/test/contract/contract.test.ts` fails. The file is packages/adapters/test/integration/contract/contract.test.ts.
findings.detail: B21 requires every golden, transcript, snapshot and contract path AGENTS.md names to exist. The repo rule that checks AGENTS.md paths does not catch this 'there' reference.
